paper_title: Knowing You Don't Know Learning When to Continue Search in Multi-round   RAG through Self-Practicing
caption: Ablation study on different Critic model choices. Both follow the SIM-RAG setting with GPT-4 as the Reasoner, but the blue bar uses learned Flan-T5-783M as a Critic, while the red bar uses GPT-4 as the Critic (a.k.a., self-critique).
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the performance of a system using different critic models, with both sets of bars representing the same tasks. The horizontal axis denotes the task name, displaying labels such as "TriviaQA(EM)," "HotPotQA(EM)," "2Wiki(EM)," "TriviaQA(F1)," "HotPotQA(F1)," and "2Wiki(F1)," presented in that order. The vertical axis represents the score, labeled as "Score", with a linear scale ranging from 25 to 85, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The blue bars represent the system's performance when using Flan-T5-783M as the critic model, while the red bars use GPT-4 as the critic. The leftmost blue bar, representing "TriviaQA(EM)," has a value of approximately 31.9, and the rightmost blue bar, "2Wiki(F1)," has a value of around 38.1. The leftmost red bar, "HotPotQA(EM)," has a value of approximately 37.0, and the rightmost red bar, “2Wiki(F1)," displays a value of about 53.3. The bars are sorted alphabetically by task name, and the values are shown directly above each bar.
